note: The keyboard and accessibility contract per component, written once and generated into every guide by scripts/a11y.mjs. A component missing from this file fails the a11y check: silence is not an answer.

button.name: The text inside it. An icon-only button has no name in this system, which is why there is not one.
keys: Moves to it; a disabled button is skipped
button.focus: Native. Never remove the focus ring: it is a token, not a style.
button.notes: `isLoading` sets `aria-busy` and leaves the button focusable, so a person is not thrown out of the page while it works.

card.name: Not required. Give the card a heading inside CardHeader instead.
card.focus: Not focusable, and must not be made clickable as a whole: put the control inside it.
card.notes: Nothing here is interactive, which is the honest answer rather than an omission.

input.name: The `label` prop, which is required.
keys: Nothing — this is not a combobox
input.focus: Native. Focus stays on the field when `isInvalid` turns on.
input.notes: `hint` is wired to the field, so a screen reader reads the error with the field rather than after it.

table.name: Give it a `<caption>`, or an `aria-label` when the heading above it already says what it is.
keys: Moves through the interactive cells only, not through every cell
table.focus: Cells are not focusable. Controls inside them are.
table.notes: Sorting controls are buttons in the header cells and must carry `aria-sort` on the cell.

modal.name: The `title` prop, which is required.
keys: Cycles inside the dialog and does not leave it
modal.focus: Moves into the dialog on open and returns to the control that opened it on close.
modal.notes: The page behind is inert while it is open. A modal that does not trap focus is a bug, not a variant.

badge.name: Not required; the badge's own words are the name.
badge.focus: Not focusable. If it needs to be, it is a Button.
badge.notes: Tone is never the only signal: the word says what the colour says.

design-tokens.name: n/a
design-tokens.notes: Contrast is a token decision: every `text-*` token is checked against every `bg-*` token it is allowed to sit on, and the pairs that fail are not exported.

patterns/list-page.name: n/a
keys: Filters, then the table, then pagination — in that order
patterns/list-page.focus: After a filter changes, focus stays on the filter; announce the new row count in a live region.
patterns/list-page.notes: The empty state is a heading and a button, not an image alone.

patterns/settings-form.name: n/a
patterns/settings-form.focus: On a failed save, focus moves to the first invalid field.
patterns/settings-form.notes: The error summary is a live region above the form and links to each field.

patterns/detail-view.name: n/a
keys: Header actions, then the content, then the side panel
patterns/detail-view.focus: Loading a new record moves focus to the record's heading.
patterns/detail-view.notes: The heading is the record's name, so a screen reader announces which record opened.

patterns/empty-state.name: n/a
patterns/empty-state.focus: The primary action is the first thing after the heading in the DOM.
patterns/empty-state.notes: Never a bare illustration: an empty state with no text is silent to a screen reader.

patterns/index.name: n/a
patterns/index.notes: Each pattern below carries its own keyboard contract.
